information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** Welcome to the first ever cubing league in Manchester! Top 16 finishers from each finals will be awarded points. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManchesterCLSecond2026#67476-manchester-cubing-league). **Please note this competition takes place on a Bank Holiday Monday.** **Only first 16 registered for 4BLD/5BLD can compete in 4BLD/5BLD.** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Kewbz.global](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYxOTcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6829e6558c1a5ecf99757e5e61782b466ebc9d7c/kewbzglobal.png)](https://kewbz.global)
